confirmed_by.patch: C's loop structure (patch A) together with rolling prefix hashes (patch B). B only removes quadratic hashing (a speed-up that cannot change a result); it is needed so the patched program finishes within confirm.py's 10 s CPU limit.

defects.note: Single patches (adatrans_confirm_run1.json): A alone makes no case agree within 10 s CPU (the quadratic hashing remains); B alone leaves every S1 case wrong; A+B makes every counted case agree. The quadratic hashing itself (C_415_4.rs:37, :50; the C rolls prefix hashes) makes the Rust slow but it finishes within the 60 s CPU hang limit on every input, so it is not counted as a defect.

defects.mechanism: count_mentions is not a translation of the C's countMentions: ALL/HERE mentions are never counted (extract_id_number of 'ALL'/'HERE' is None), and after every event every user whose online counter is 0 gains a mention; events are read one per line where the C reads exactly three tokens per event. Several mechanisms in one rewritten function; counted as ONE defect (lower bound). Rejected by AdaTrans's own loop (status FAILURE).

crashes.note: Rust panics/crashes on UB-clean C inputs, reported separately from S1

whitespace_only_not_counted.note: stdout equal after whitespace folding (mostly a trailing space the C prints, or the C's missing final newline); the artifact's own check folds whitespace

not_counted_detail.why: Rust panics ('attempt to subtract with overflow', C_424_4.rs:28) on 3 of our inputs where the C prints a value and passes gcc ASan+UBSan, -O1/-O2 and char-signedness checks; the clang leg of the UB rule cannot run because the C uses GCC nested functions (clang: 'function definition is not allowed here'). Not counted under the rule; candidate panic.

Rust overflows its stack (deep recursion) on 26 of our and 8 of AdaTrans's fuzz inputs where the plain C prints a value; clang ASan reports stack-overflow in the C on the same inputs, so the UB rule excludes them.
C itself segfaults (stack overflow, ASan stack-overflow) on 12 of our and 1 fuzz input; Rust prints a value. C-UB, excluded.
1 input: C heap-buffer-overflow (ASan), Rust panics index out of bounds. C-UB, excluded.
1 input: Rust stack overflow; clang ASan stack-overflow in the C. Excluded.
2 of its panic cases: input longer than the C's fixed buffer (stack-buffer-overflow). Excluded; the other 81 panics are counted.
1 hang case each where the C output depends on -O2 or char signedness. Excluded.

heldout.status: measured (AdaTrans records both check input sets: loop examples and fuzz oracle, in the Zenodo bundle)

loop_examples_disagree_with_C.note: AdaTrans's loop compares the Rust against the recorded example outputs (LeetCode's), not against the C; on these problems the C does not produce the recorded output

harness_power.fault_injection: every confirm.py patch is the converse experiment: removing one mechanism turns the harness green on its cases; the mutation analysis below injects faults into agreeing translations

determinism.seeds: none: inputs are a function of (fuzz script, input index k, draw index c) only (Kronecker frac(k*sqrt(p_c)), splitmix64(k, c) beyond 3000 draws); rand::random in a translation (C_415_4) and srand(time(NULL)) in the C (415_4) are the programs' own randomness
nondeterminism_sources_left: timeouts (10 s / 60 s) decide 'hang'; a program near the limit can flip
sanitizer report text is normalised (PIDs, addresses) before it is stored
